{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Interbay is a neighborhood in Seattle, Washington in the United States consisting of the valley between Queen Anne Hill on the east and Magnolia on the west, plus filled-in areas of Smith Cove and Salmon Bay.","title":"Interbay, Seattle"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The neighborhood is bounded on the north by Salmon Bay, part of the Lake Washington Ship Canal, across which is Ballard; on the south by what remains of Smith Cove, an inlet of Elliott Bay; on the east by 15th Avenue W. and Elliott Avenue W.; and on the west by Thorndyke, 20th, and Gilman Avenues W.","title":"Interbay, Seattle"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The Ballard Bridge crosses the ship canal from Interbay to Ballard.","title":"Interbay, Seattle"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Lake Union is a freshwater lake entirely within the Seattle, Washington city limits and a major portion of the Lake Washington Ship Canal.","title":"Lake Union"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Its easternmost point is the Ship Canal Bridge, which carries Interstate 5 over the eastern arm of the lake and separates Lake Union from Portage Bay.","title":"Lake Union"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Lake Union is the namesake of the neighborhoods located on its east and west shores: Eastlake and Westlake, respectively.","title":"Lake Union"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The northern shore of the lake is home to Gas Works Park.","title":"Lake Union"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" Notable features of the southern portion of the lake—collectively known as the South Lake Union district—include Lake Union Park, Museum of History & Industry (MOHAI), and the Center for Wooden Boats.","title":"Lake Union"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"On which coast can the California Aqueduct and the Lake Washington Ship Canal be found?
